top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a clear conceptual advance, the Z2 time-reversal-invariant topological insulator and quantum spin Hall state, with a decisive measurement of quantised helical edge conductance in HgTe wells and about two decades of independent confirmation. The Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang gap and the 2016 topological-phases prize are real costs, but a citation bounded to the Z2 state and its first observation is defensible. P002 is second because its theory is the model its experiment tested, though seven years of confirmation with the pairing mechanism open and the Cao co-first-author problem argue for waiting. P003 is mature and cleanly allocated, but its distinctness from the 2005 and 2012 precision-measurement prizes is uncertain. A prize this year is preferable to none.
